name: Indorin's Tomb
description: The tomb from which Kyree must steal something valuable.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyree takes the Ivory Cup from Indorin's sarcophagus, awakening Adriel, who chases her; Kyree escapes with an angel's feather and completes her rite.
timeline.quote: This feather is even more valued in the eyes of her tribe than the cup
